summary: v43.40 backend testing: Exim 24h backfill (trigger/signal/ack) and outbound geo-stats endpoints validated end-to-end plus regression on exim-log-push/checkpoint/dev-seed-sample. All 10 tests passed against public preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: outbound.py is 1081 lines — consider splitting into sub-modules (exim, backfill, geo) for maintainability.

geo-stats uses in-memory aggregation with .limit(10000); for high-volume tenants this may truncate silently. Consider MongoDB aggregation pipeline or paginated cursor with a warning field in the response when the limit is hit.

geo-stats country roll-up uses sum-over-all-domains but response only exposes top_domains[:20]; consumers may see country totals > sum of visible domains — already handled in test but worth documenting in API contract.
backfill-ack has no auth (any caller with a license_key can clear the pending flag). Consider requiring the license key's stored server_token like other plugin endpoints.
seed_data_creation: None — used the 60+ preseeded outbound events per note.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New v43.40 endpoints: POST /api/outbound/exim-backfill/trigger (X-Master-Key), GET /api/outbound/backfill-signal?license_key=, POST /api/outbound/backfill-ack, GET /api/outbound/geo-stats?hours=. Regression: exim-log-push accepts license_key body (demo allowlisted). Test file: test_v43_40_backfill_geostats.py.
